init.title: Connection and write access
init.description: Read-only blocks writes. Only Save sends day schedules and mode periods. Local connections allow a normal polling interval of 15–900 seconds, default 60. Shorter intervals increase traffic. This is an integration limit, not a WOLF specification. Immediate readback checks and connection keepalive remain independent. Pending confirmation temporarily uses 15-second polling. Changes apply without reloading the integration.
